summary.text: Daniel Grossberg is a Democratic member of the Kentucky House of Representatives representing District 30, serving since 2023. The legislature's profile lists Grossberg's education as a B.A. in general science from Grinnell College and notes U.S. Army service.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's profile, Daniel Grossberg was born on September 30, 1978.
The profile lists a B.A. in general science from Grinnell College and U.S. Army service.
